"""RoboPaint 大: camera-calibrated three-stroke brush writing.
Uses only standard Robot observations, kinematics and motion commands.
All sent trajectories and observations are retained in output/runs.
"""
import sys, os, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT='/app/output'
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.])
SURFACE=.0202
SCALE=.227185/1024
r=None
cur=None

def connect():
 global r,cur
 r=Robot(); o=r.get_obs(cameras=[]);cur=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14]);return o

def send(rows,note='',cameras=['practice_cam'],dt=.05):
 global cur
 rows=np.asarray(rows)
 for k in range(0,len(rows),180):
  a=rows[k:k+180]
  stamp=str(time.time_ns()); folder=OUT+'/runs/'+stamp;os.makedirs(folder)
  np.save(folder+'/actions.npy',a)
  open(folder+'/request.json','w').write(json.dumps({'type':'ee_pose','dt':dt,'note':note}))
  z=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=dt,cameras=cameras,video='frames',video_fps=20,note=note)
  z.save(folder)
  for c,im in z.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT+'/'+c+'.png')
  cur=np.array(z.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14]);
  print(note,'rows',len(a),'now',cur[:3].round(6).tolist(),'plan',z.meta.get('plan'),'left',z.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
  if z.stopped or z.done:raise RuntimeError(z.meta)
 return z

def line(target,seconds=.8,note='move',cameras=['practice_cam']):
 t=np.r_[target,Q] if len(target)==3 else np.array(target)
 n=max(1,round(seconds/.05)); rows=np.linspace(cur,t,n+1)[1:];return send(rows,note,cameras)

def hold(seconds=.3):return send(np.tile(cur,(round(seconds/.05),1)),'settle')
def lift():line([*cur[:2],.065],.65,'lift')
def dip():
 lift();line([-.1,.15,.065],2.5,'travel to ink');line([-.1,.15,.022],.8,'dip');hold(.3);lift()
def park():
 lift();line([-.1,.15,.1],2.5,'park',cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam'])
def practice_lines():
 dip()
 for i,depth in enumerate([.001,.003,.005,.008,.012,.018]):
  x=-.015-i*.032
  line([x,-.155,.060],1.5,'practice position')
  line([x,-.155,SURFACE-depth],1.,f'press {depth}')
  line([x,-.215,SURFACE-depth],4.,f'line {depth}')
  lift()
 park()

if __name__=='__main__':
 connect()

 elif sys.argv[1]=='park':park()
